Static vs instance variable: A STATIC variable belongs to the class — one shared copy for all objects, created at class loading, accessed as ClassName.var. An INSTANCE variable belongs to each object — every object gets its own copy, created with new, accessed via the object reference. Changing a static variable affects all objects; changing an instance variable affects only that object.
